question: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. What is the price of the ball in dollars? Put only the decimal number, without a currency symbol or units, in prediction.claim.

Five identical machines take five minutes to make five widgets. Each machine works independently at a constant rate. How many minutes do 100 machines take to make 100 widgets? Put only the integer number of minutes in prediction.claim.
A Byzantine fault-tolerant system requires n >= 3f + 1 nodes to tolerate f faulty nodes. With 7 nodes, what is the largest integer f it can tolerate? Put only the integer in prediction.claim.
All glips are blons. Some blons are trels. Does it necessarily follow that some glips are trels? Put only true or false in prediction.claim.

Two equal-weight temperature readings are 32 degrees Fahrenheit and 20 degrees Celsius. Convert to Celsius before averaging. What is the mean in Celsius? Put only the integer number in prediction.claim.
